title: JSM - Jewellery Shop Management Desktop Application
description: A desktop operations system for inventory, billing, and workflow management in jewellery retail environments.

story.problem: Retail operations needed a reliable desktop tool to manage inventory, billing, and cross-table updates without data inconsistency.
story.approach: I designed normalized data models and modular APIs so critical business operations remained accurate and maintainable.
story.architecture: Implemented a SQLite-backed relational schema with Sequelize transaction handling, exposed through modular services, and delivered through an Electron + Vite desktop interface.
story.results: The application provided a practical, workflow-focused management layer that improved day-to-day retail operations.
